Are you making the most of your commute? 🚆

When your journey gives you time to read, listen to a podcast or catch up on emails before work, we think that’s time well spent 🤩

And with a Northern Season Ticket, there are plenty more journeys to make the most of!

#NorthernTrains

When I’m building collections, research is non-negotiable, but reading every report top to bottom just isn’t realistic, especially when focus is already a challenge.

Lately, I’ve been turning long research docs into audio with Generate podcast in @adobeacrobat so I can listen while I work, sketch, and plan. It’s helped me move through information faster without cutting corners or skipping the thinking part.

If research is part of your process, this has been a game changer for mine.

#AdobeAcrobatPartner
Turn PDFs into podcast-style audio and catch-up on work wherever you go.

A “deep-sea fossil megasite” has been discovered.

It’s the world’s deepest known whale graveyard - or necropolis - and was discovered by Chinese researchers, diving along 1200 kilometres of the seafloor in a crewed submersible.

They described the experience as eerie - and even noticed new species and lifeforms never seen before. 

Rowan Hooper discusses this incredible finding with reporter James Woodford.

Hear the full story on The World, the Universe and Us, a news podcast for the insatiably curious.

Learn more⁠: https://www.newscientist.com/podcasts/

#WhaleGraveyard, #AncientFossils, #DeepSea, #Discovery, #SciencePodcast, #Science, #ScienceFacts, #NewScientist, #Podcast
